workday_host.description: Hostname of your Workday API endpoint, without the 'https://' prefix and without any trailing path or slash. This is the host part of your Workday URLs, which depends on your datacenter and environment. Example: 'wd3-impl-services1.workday.com' (implementation/sandbox) or 'wd3-services1.myworkday.com' (production).

tenant_name.description: Your Workday tenant identifier (also called 'tenant ID'), not your company display name, and it is case-sensitive. The easiest place to find it is the address bar once signed in to Workday: in 'https://wd3-impl-services1.workday.com/acme/d/home.htmld', the tenant name is 'acme'. Enter the identifier alone, with no slashes.

client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID of the Workday API Client used to collect the logs. It is a long alphanumeric string, such as 'LzgTHQbN9F2Tsn43Y8eA4vVY8xF693U0eepeDVm4yaZkIp8m'.

client_secret.description: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret paired with the Client ID above.

refresh_token.description: Non-expiring OAuth 2.0 refresh token issued for the integration system user tied to the API Client above.
